name: OurWorld Global Network
summary: Sydney wholesale/dialup ISP (ourworld.net, DirectIP wholesale services); sponsor of the ISP.au conference; defunct.

events.details: Acquired iiNet SA (Adelaide, ex-iiNet) as the foundation for its planned national 'super aggregator' Internet access service; the venture failed quietly in 1998.

refs.label: LinkedIn: John Lindsay — sold iiNet SA to the 'super aggregator'; bought customers for Chariot from the liquidator

events.details: OGN's media releases (e.g. the Auslink flat-rate launch, 7 May 1998) were disseminated via the ASX feed of Barton Capital Holdings Limited (ASX.BCH, issuer 3429, ACN 064 874 620; ex-Auschina Corporation Limited, renamed 15 Jan 1997) — a Sydney listed shell/investment firm. The relationship is unclear; possibly the listed vehicle or investor behind OGN's national aggregation ambitions.

refs.label: ASX: media releases by Ourworld Global Network Pty Ltd, filed under Barton Capital Holdings Ltd (7 May 1998)
delisted.com.au: Barton Capital Holdings Ltd (BCH) — ex-Auschina Corporation
SMH (4 Jun 2002): 'Ailing Barton Capital axes staff, closes core operations'

events.details: Failed quietly in 1998 and was liquidated; customer base (incl. ex-iiNet SA) bought from the liquidator by Chariot (via John Lindsay).
